_README: Modules that no other module imports. This list is a BASELINE SNAPSHOT taken
when the check was written, not a set of blessed exemptions: every entry is
marked UNTRIAGED and each one is a question nobody has answered yet.
Its purpose is to make the check fail on anything NEW, so the count can only
go down. Removing an entry means the module was wired or deleted; changing a
reason means somebody looked. Do not add an entry without a reason a later
reader can act on -- 'not used yet' is how the four findings this exists for
became invisible in the first place.

dark.apfs_cow_cleanroom: Test-infrastructure module with no importer outside the tests it serves. UNTRIAGED baseline 2026-09-01.

dark.docs_findability_index: RETIRE, measured 2026-09-01: it maintains docs/guide/INDEX.md and docs/archive/_INDEX.md, and neither directory exists here -- docs/ is flat, 51 files, no guide/ and no archive/. Running it does not check anything; it CREATES two index documents this repo never had, which doc_deletion_guard would then protect forever. Extraction residue from the private repo's docs hierarchy. Delete the module and tests/lints/test_docs_findability_index.py, or port the docs layout first; do not wire it as a gate.

Wiring it means changing how CI runs the whole suite (shard budgets, RSS ceilings, a receipt path under the gitignored .coordharness/), which is a workflow decision with a far larger blast radius than a lint driver. Decide it as a CI change, not as a dark-module cleanup.
